archetypes.name: guideline-drift-correctness
archetypes.rationale: The fix must recover from HEAD drift without silently accepting invalid or missing diff evidence.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the refresh-and-retry flow preserves fail-closed fingerprint validation. Check that live diff failures, missing repo roots, and symlinked artifacts still fall back to existing drop behavior. Verify that tests cover both successful drift recovery and unchanged strict mismatch behavior. Cite the exact plan bullet or repository path that supports each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
